title: 🌕Blood Moons
author: Jonathan Hill

body:
Blood Moons are a special event that can activate during the Halloween season on Silver Springs.

  • 🌕When a full moon rises in the survival or resource world, a Blood Moon activates - a sleepless night of dangerous foes.

  • 🌑Enemies which spawn under the light of the Blood Moon are stronger and drop better loot:

    • 🩻Wither Skeletons with fiery bows and Zombified Piglins spawn in the overworld throughout the night.

    • 💪These enemies, and all others, are bigger, stronger, and faster. Creepers explode in a wider radius, leaving behind enfeebling clouds.

    • 🦾Empowered enemies drop additional XP, uncommonly an occult item (same pool as Dowsing Thumb), and rarely the Sanguine Phial charm.

  • 🩸The Sanguine Phial stacks at double rate for kills during Blood Moons.
